description: Additive oscillator summing a sine wave and its first fifteen harmonics, with the amplitudes generated at random or fed in on one polyphonic cable

params.text: Generates a new set of amplitudes for the sixteen sine waves

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the output at a volt per octave
A rising edge generates a new set of amplitudes for the sixteen sine waves
Sixteen-channel polyphonic input that takes over the amplitudes of the fundamental and its harmonics; the location output keeps its own generated values while this is patched

outputs.text: Audio output of the summed sine waves
Sixteen-channel polyphonic output carrying the amplitude of the fundamental and each of its fifteen harmonics

notes: Bypassing this module leaves every output at 0V
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
